description: KULIC Advisory Comic Library: comics from twenty years of procurement and transformation practice, no clients and no figures. Three series: noir (book pages on ownership, ambiguity and the price of truth), transformation (shared services, sourcing and system roll-out journeys up to go-live, companies and systems invented or neutral) and german (four stories in German). Without a query it lists the whole library; with a query it returns the best matches by keywords in the titles (no AI). Each entry has the title, series, language of the comic, the image links of all versions and the page link. Show the images with KULIC Advisory as the source and the link to the library; sharing with a link is welcome, use in own documents after agreement. No sign-in, nothing stored.

language.description: Language of the answer text. Default de. The comics themselves are in English or German.

limit.description: Number of matches when a query is given. Default 6.

query.description: Optional keywords, for example 'ownership', 'go-live', 'GBS' or 'One Procurement'.

name: find_comic
title: Find comics from the KULIC Advisory Comic Library
